unsupported_claims: DeepWalk has weaker Macro-F1 than EdgeCluster at 3% training ratio on Flickr (accepts false premise); the paper says DeepWalk outperforms the baselines.
DeepWalk's embeddings favor hub-centered structure and fail to separate minority-label groups, so EdgeCluster is more discriminative for small classes and gets higher Macro-F1.
EdgeCluster's edge-centric community features align better with group structure, giving it higher Macro-F1 than DeepWalk.
rationale: The answer goes along with the false premise and invents a mechanism for EdgeCluster beating DeepWalk in Macro-F1 on Flickr. The evidence shows DeepWalk outperforms EdgeCluster and the other baselines there, starting close to SpectralClustering in Macro-F1 and then pulling ahead. The generic point about Macro-F1 weighting classes equally is background, but it does not rescue the core claim.
